info.title: Maihan Gems Catalog API
info.description: Maihan Gems catalogue read API (Phase 3). [INFERRED / PROPOSED] target API per PROJECT_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md section 11; the source site exposed no observable API surface. All catalogue endpoints are public GET reads; provenance (source URL, evidence status, import batch) travels on every product and stone response. Unmatched paths return NOT_FOUND; non-GET methods return METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED. Clients exceeding the SoT 11.11 public-GET rate limit (300/min per IP) receive 429 RATE_LIMITED.
